user.title: Create a PT Alarm panel
user.description: Give your alarm panel a name and, optionally, a first user code. Next you can add sensors. Everything can be changed later under **Configure**.

data_description.code: At least 4 characters. Digits-only codes give you a numeric keypad.

sensors.title: Add sensors
sensors.description: Choose the door, window, motion and other sensors that belong to this alarm. You can skip this and add sensors later.

Name the zone, choose how it behaves (zone type), what device it is and where it is.

data_description.name: Shown on the device page, the card, notifications and the activity log.
data_description.zone_type: Entry/Exit 1 and 2 give an entry delay (2 is usually the longer one, e.g. a back door). Perimeter is instant. Interior zones are off in Stay; an interior follower waits for a running entry delay. Fire is always on. Supervisory and Tamper only report a trouble.
data_description.type: What the device is. Sets the icon and wording (Open, Motion, Detected).
data_description.area: Optional. Notifications will say, for example, "Front door in Hallway".
data_description.chime: Plays a chime on the dashboard card when this zone opens while disarmed.

automations.title: Automations and access control
automations.description: Choose whether automations, schedules and access control systems (for example UniFi Access) may arm and disarm this partition with the pt_alarm.arm and pt_alarm.disarm actions. A disarm is never accepted while the alarm is sounding.

data.automation_allowed: Allow arming and disarming by automations
data.automation_open_zones: When an automation arms while zones are open
data.automation_anonymous: Trust access control: allow disarm without a PT user

data_description.automation_allowed: Off: only the keypad (with a code) can arm and disarm.
data_description.automation_open_zones: Refuse and notify, or bypass the open zones, arm, and notify which zones were bypassed.
data_description.automation_anonymous: On: a disarm from an automation or access system is accepted even if the person is not a PT user (their name is still logged if it is sent). Names that match a PT user always follow that user's rules.

data_description.code: At least 4 characters. Digits only gives a numeric keypad.

data_description.valid_until: Leave the dates empty for a permanent code.
data_description.blocked_by: The code is refused while any of these is on, for example a Holiday calendar, a Yom Tov sensor or a vacation switch.
data_description.partitions: Which partitions this code works in. The same user and code are kept in sync in every partition you tick.
data_description.access_ids: Names or IDs this person has in your access control system (for example their UniFi Access name or card number). Automations can then arm or disarm as this user.

Choose whether automations, schedules and access control systems (for example UniFi Access) may arm and disarm this partition with the pt_alarm.arm and pt_alarm.disarm actions. A disarm is never accepted while the alarm is sounding.

Click **Submit** without changes to go back to the menu.

sirens.title: Sirens
sirens.description:
These are turned on when the alarm sounds and off when it is disarmed or the siren time ends.

Click **Submit** without changes to go back to the menu.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description:
Pick the notifiers you already set up in Home Assistant (for example an SMTP email notifier, the mobile app or Twilio SMS) and tick the events for each channel. Untick an event to stop it.

Click **Submit** without changes to go back to the menu.

data.email_html: Email: use the PowerTech HTML design
data.push_services: Push / SMS: phones, SMS or other notifiers
data.push_events: Push / SMS: send for these events

data_description.email_services: Your email notifier, for example notify.email_notify (SMTP). Notifiers set up in YAML get the HTML email; notifiers set up from the UI (marked 'plain text') get a plain-text email.
data_description.email_html: Branded email with a colored status banner. Put your own pt_alarm_email.html in the config folder to use your own design.
data_description.push_services: For example notify.mobile_app_my_phone or notify.twilio_sms. Alarm and fire pushes break through quiet modes on phones.
